typography.headingCharacter: Extremely heavy grotesk sans at huge display size, tight tracking, straight/square terminals, mixed case, letters set close enough that an inset photo can substitute for one
typography.bodyCharacter: Small bold grotesk sans for nav links and teaser copy, tight leading, short measure, all set in the same family as the headline

composition.structure: Full-width thin top nav; one giant centred two-line wordmark spans the viewport, its two words split by a small inset photo standing in for a letter; utility text pinned to the four corners.

spacing.rhythm: Vast open canvas surrounding one dominant central wordmark; small utility text (nav, now-playing, sound toggle, teaser) held tightly to the four corners

surfaceTreatment.finish: plain flat fills, solid black type on white, no shadow or texture anywhere visible

imagery.treatment: One small grayscale photo bled directly into the display wordmark in place of a letterform, no frame or border, otherwise no imagery on the page

motion.character: PK roundel spins continuously (12s); equalizer bars flash on a 1s loop. Scroll (GSAP/Lenis) drives staggered reveals, parallax shifts, and a sticky header down the 12-viewport page, eased on a custom snappy cubic-bezier curve.
motion.choreography: Content reveals arrive in stages while scrolling rather than all at once - about a quarter of tracked elements fade or slide in at their own depth, a smaller set of images and text drift at different rates than the scroll or pin in place, and the header stays fixed and resizes.

philosophy.text: The page treats the artist's name as the entire interface: a single poster-scale wordmark fills the frame while chrome is reduced to thin utility text anchored at the four corners, so nothing competes with typographic scale. Splicing a small monochrome photo into the wordmark, in place of a letter, fuses portrait and brand mark into one typographic object rather than pairing image and headline as separate elements. Ambient details — a slowly spinning mark, a flashing now-playing indicator — signal that the site is alive and audio-driven without introducing any color or ornament that would dilute the black-on-white restraint. The trade is legibility of navigation and content preview: almost everything is deferred behind a single dominant gesture, betting entirely on scale and confidence over immediate wayfinding.
